class.name: EditorFormRow
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A responsive label, editor, description, and status row for editor forms.
class.description: Provides consistent alignment and accessibility for ordinary dialog and tool fields. At narrow widths, the label and editing control wrap without separating the editor from its contents. This component only owns presentation; the containing screen owns validation and data mutation.

method.name: clear_status
method.description: Removes the current inline status message.

method.name: get_editor
method.description: Returns the editing control assigned to this row.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the current inline status severity.

method.name: get_status_text
method.description: Returns the current inline status text.

method.name: set_editor
method.description: Assigns the row's editing control. The row takes ownership of it and accepts one editor control.

method.name: set_status
method.description: Displays an inline status message with the requested semantic severity.

members.member: Optional help text shown below the main row.
Field label associated with the editing control.
Whether the field displays a semantic, warning-colored required-field indicator.
